Shell(mkdir -p "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD" && cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/cmd_usage_test.exp" <<'EXPECT' set timeout 30 log_user 1 spawn -noecho sh -c {cd "$HOME" && stty rows 30 columns 100 && exec cmd} expect { -re {>} {} timeout { puts stderr "TIMED OUT waiting for prompt"; exit 1 } eof { puts stderr "CMD EXITED EARLY"; exit 1 } } sleep 2 send -- "/usage\r" expect { -re {([Uu]sage|credits|Credits|plan|Plan)} {} timeout { puts stderr "TIMED OUT reading usage"; exit 1 } eof { puts stderr "CMD EXITED before usage"; exit 1 } } sleep 4 send -- "/exit\r" expect eof EXPECT /usr/bin/expect "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/cmd_usage_test.exp" 2>&1 | head -80)

Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/cmd_usage_test.exp" <<'EXPECT' set timeout 30 log_user 1 spawn -noecho sh -c {cd "$HOME" && stty rows 40 columns 100 && exec cmd} expect { -re {Ask your question} {} timeout { puts stderr "TIMED OUT waiting for prompt"; exit 1 } eof { puts stderr "CMD EXITED EARLY"; exit 1 } } sleep 3 send -- "/usage\r" expect { -re {redits} {} timeout { puts stderr "TIMED OUT reading usage"; exit 1 } eof { puts stderr "CMD EXITED before usage"; exit 1 } } sleep 3 send -- "/exit\r" expect eof EXPECT /usr/bin/expect "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/cmd_usage_test.exp" 2>&1 | tail -60)

Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/cmd_usage_test.exp" <<'EXPECT' set timeout 40 log_user 1 spawn -noecho sh -c {cd "$HOME" && stty rows 40 columns 100 && exec cmd} expect { -re {for shortcuts} {} timeout { puts stderr "TIMED OUT waiting for prompt"; exit 1 } eof { puts stderr "CMD EXITED EARLY"; exit 1 } } sleep 3 send -- "/usage\r" sleep 6 send -- "/exit\r" expect eof EXPECT /usr/bin/expect "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/cmd_usage_test.exp" 2>&1 | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]//g' | grep -v '^\s*$' | tail -50)

Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/panel.exp" <<'EXPECT' set timeout 25 log_user 0 log_file -a $env(COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD)/panel.log spawn -noecho sh -c {cd "$HOME" && stty rows 40 columns 100 && exec cmd "/usage"} expect { -re {redits|Plan|plan} {} timeout { puts stderr "TIMED OUT waiting for panel"; exit 1 } eof { puts stderr "CMD EXITED EARLY"; exit 1 } } sleep 5 exit 0 EXPECT rm -f "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/panel.log"; /usr/bin/expect "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/panel.exp"; sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]//g' "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/panel.log" | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | tail -40)
Shell(pgrep:*)

Shell(LOG="$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/panel.log"; ls -la "$LOG" 2>/dev/null; esc=$'\033'; bel=$'\007'; csi_re="${esc}\\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]"; osc_re="${esc}\\][^${esc}${bel}]*(${bel}|${esc}\\\\)"; sed -E "s/${osc_re}//g; s/${csi_re}//g; s/${esc}//g" "$LOG" | tr -d '\000\r' | grep -a -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | cat -A | tail -14)

Shell(bash -n ~/.bash_agents && echo OK; bash -c ' # verify pipefail preserves a failing expect status through the tr pipeline r="$(set -o pipefail; { /usr/bin/expect -c "exit 3"; } | tr -d "\000")"; echo "fail-case status: $?" r="$(set -o pipefail; { /usr/bin/expect -c "puts hello; exit 0"; } | tr -d "\000")"; echo "ok-case status: $?"; printf "%s\n" "$r"')
